purpose: Resolve product-level taxonomy semantics independently from image-candidate rights. This registry never approves image binaries or publication rights.

records.rationale: The product label is a broad angling category while Japanese fisheries references distinguish multiple カレイ species. Do not bind the category to the current マコガレイ image candidate.

The product method data is a deep-water boat target and explicitly includes イズカサゴ as a synonym. FRA material distinguishes イズカサゴ Scorpaena neglecta from standard オニカサゴ Scorpaenopsis cirrosa, so the current cirrosa candidate must not be used for this product intent.

The product label and aliases represent a freshwater multi-species angling category. Japanese fisheries references also use タナゴ as another name for ウミタナゴ, reinforcing that one species image would be misleading.

FRA lists ヒイカ as another name for ジンドウイカ, but the product aliases also include コイカ・テッポウイカ・ベイカ. Preserve the product as a small-coastal-squid category instead of silently binding all aliases to one species image.
The product alias intent is マエソ. JAMSTEC BISMaL identifies Saurida macrolepis as マエソ; do not substitute other Saurida species imagery.
The product method data explicitly groups マルイカ with ケンサキイカ. JAMSTEC BISMaL accepts Uroteuthis (Photololigo) edulis as ケンサキイカ; image rights still require a separate licensed candidate.
